data.name: AllPrintSystemsFailed
data.value: Every print system failed. The inner exception lists each failure.
data.comment: Thrown when several print systems are registered and all of them fail.

data.name: OptionsNotApplied
data.value: The printer '{0}' doesn't apply these print options, so the job was refused rather than printed without them: {1}. Leave them at their defaults for this printer.
data.comment: {0} is the printer ID; {1} lists the PrintOptions settings, such as "Copies, Duplex".
